description: Unit tests for ContextHostResolver in the net/dns module, testing DNS resolution, cache behavior, network binding, and shutdown handling.

classes.name: ContextHostResolverTest
classes.description: Test fixture for ContextHostResolver unit tests, setting up DNS configs and resolver manager.

classes.name: NetworkBoundResolveContext
classes.description: ResolveContext subclass that binds to a specific network handle.

classes.name: NetworkAwareHostResolverProc
classes.description: Mock HostResolverProc that returns different IPs based on network handle.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Test DNS resolution for example.com with various schemes and IP literals.

methods.name: DestroyRequest
methods.description: Test that destroying a request cancels it silently.

methods.name: DohProbeRequest
methods.description: Test creation and starting of DoH probe requests.

methods.name: ExistingNetworkBoundLookup
methods.description: Test DNS lookup with a context bound to a specific network handle.

methods.name: NotExistingNetworkBoundLookup
methods.description: Test DNS lookup with a non-bound context, expecting network change error.

methods.name: HostCacheInvalidation
methods.description: Test that cache invalidations do not occur when bound to a network.

methods.name: OnShutdown_PendingRequest
methods.description: Test behavior of a pending request when resolver is shut down.

methods.name: OnShutdown_CompletedRequests
methods.description: Test behavior of completed requests when resolver is shut down.

methods.name: OnShutdown_DelayedStartRequest
methods.description: Test behavior of a delayed request created before shutdown.

methods.name: OnShutdown_DelayedStartDohProbeRequest
methods.description: Test delayed DoH probe request created before shutdown.

methods.name: ResolveFromCache
methods.description: Test cache retrieval with stale and fresh entries.

methods.name: ResultsAddedToCache
methods.description: Test adding DNS results to cache and retrieving them.

methods.name: ResultsAddedToCacheWithNetworkIsolationKey
methods.description: Test cache entries with NetworkIsolationKey and cache splitting.
